segments.title: The sidebar can sit on the right
segments.body: On a New Tab page, open Make it yours and pick Right under the layout cards: the sidebar moves to the window's right edge. It's also in Settings › Tabs and View › Sidebar on Right. 0.2.44-nightly.3 has no such option; its panel ends at the layout cards.

segments.title: New-tab links stay in Little Ardia
segments.body: Settings › General › “Open new-tab links inside Little Ardia” on, then click a target=_blank link in Little Ardia: the page loads right there, so Back takes you back. 0.2.44-nightly.3 has no such setting and opens the link as a tab in the main window, behind.

segments.title: Open in Ardia lands where new tabs go
segments.body: “New tabs open at” is set to Top. Open in Ardia on a Little Ardia page now puts the tab at the top of the list, where ⌘T would. 0.2.44-nightly.3 always put it at the bottom.
